extension.summary: Live TV, guide, recordings and timers from EPGStation
EPGStation のライブ視聴・番組表・録画・予約
extension.description: Kodi's own TV screens for EPGStation 2.x, the Japanese ISDB TV recorder that works with Mirakurun: live TV, the programme guide with Japanese genres, recordings (also while they are still recording, and encoded files) and reservations and rules (record a programme or a whole series from the guide). Several EPGStation servers can be added as separate instances.
EPGStation 2.x（Mirakurun と組み合わせて使う日本のテレビ録画サーバー）を Kodi 標準のテレビ画面で使えるようにします。ライブ視聴、ジャンル付きの番組表、録画の再生（録画中の追っかけ再生、エンコード済みファイルにも対応）、予約とルール（番組表から単発予約・シリーズ予約）。複数の EPGStation をそれぞれ別インスタンスとして追加できます。
extension.disclaimer: It can create and delete reservations, rules and recordings on your EPGStation. Not affiliated with the EPGStation project. Watching and recording depend on your own EPGStation and Mirakurun setup.
EPGStation の予約・ルール・録画の作成と削除を行います。EPGStation プロジェクトとは無関係の非公式アドオンです。視聴・録画はお使いの EPGStation と Mirakurun の環境に依存します。
extension.news:
v1.1.0 (2026-10-16) - Kodi 22 "Piers" (builds for Linux, Windows and Android, from the same repository) - Fixed: seeking in a recording that is still recording jumped back to the start (Kodi 22, and Kodi 21 builds with FFmpeg 7) - Fixed: switching "prevent duplicate episodes" off on a rule made in EPGStation's web UI failed - Backend disk space shown in Kodi - "Record series": the episodes show up in Kodi within seconds, not up to a minute - Fewer requests at startup, quieter log while EPGStation is unreachable
v1.0.0 (2026-10-13) - First stable release: the 0.9.0 features, confirmed in real use
v0.9.0 (2026-10-13) - Work in progress: first public preview - Live TV from EPGStation (original broadcast or a transcoded stream mode) - Programme guide with Japanese genres and colours, updated when EPGStation's guide changes - Recordings: play, seek, delete; watch while recording; play the encoded file when there is one - Timers: record from the guide or by channel and time; reservations from EPGStation listed with their state - Timer rules: keyword rules, "Record series" from the guide, EPGStation's own rules - English and Japanese
